content_sections.heading: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Bamangachi PGT(Physics) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the last date or the application fee.

PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Bamangachi, PO- Salkia, Distt.- Howrah, PIN-711106
Candidates meeting the essential qualification, with age not more than 65 years

content_sections.heading: About the School
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Bamangachi is a school in Howrah. It is preparing a panel of part-time contractual PGT (Physics) teachers for the session 2026-27, and the notice is signed by its Principal.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice covers one post, PGT (Physics). The posts are purely on contractual basis, and the notice asks candidates to follow the KVS Recruitment Rules (Essential Qualification-2025) of KVS, the notification for which is printed in the notice as cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/documents/Detailed_Notification_KVS_NVS_2025_13112025.pdf. (a) Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institution/University, in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate including B.Ed. component; OR Master Degree from a recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the concerned subject. AND (b) B.Ed. Degree from NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks; OR Three years Integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks; OR Four years Integrated Degree with at least 50% marks from NCTE recognized Institution/University including B.Ed. component. AND (c) Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English medium. Note: Master Degree in Physics, provided the candidate has studied Physics at graduation level also. Experience of working in a recognized school in the concerned subject. Knowledge of computer application. The upper age limit is not more than 65 years. The application form carries a line "Age as on 01.01.2026". The notice prints no age relaxation. For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The downloaded application form (Bio Data / Application Form for Contractual Appointment, session 2026-27), filled in, with a photograph at the PHOTO space. Photocopies of all educational qualifications. Originals of Academic/Professional/Caste certificates, kept ready for verification only. The application form asks for personal details, address, mobile numbers and email ID, educational and professional qualifications (including B.Ed., M.Ed. and CTET), experience, proficiency in games, sports, music, art, debate or quiz, proficiency in languages, and the total number of enclosures. It ends with an undertaking signed by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at the venue between 8.30 AM and 09.00 AM on 28.11.2026. No candidate is allowed after 09.00 AM. The application form is printed, filled and submitted at the time of verification. Verifying officials record whether the candidate is eligible for the interview (Yes/No). A screening test may be conducted as per need. The selection panel is prepared on merit basis. Selected candidates will be called as and when a vacancy arises, in order of priority in the panel.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid or admissible for attending the interview. The interview may be cancelled or rescheduled due to any unforeseen reason. The engagement is part-time and purely on contractual basis for the session 2026-27; remuneration is as per KVS norms. Candidature will be automatically cancelled if any information in the form is found wrong or false. Verifying officials may mention a remark in red ink if they find any wrong information.

faq.question: Q1. When is the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Bamangachi PGT (Physics) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 28.11.2026 (Saturday).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 8.30 AM and 09.00 AM on 28.11.2026. No candidate will be allowed after 09.00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview held?
faq.answer: At PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Bamangachi, PO- Salkia, Distt.- Howrah, PIN-711106.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for PGT (Physics)?
faq.answer: An Integrated PG course or Master Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks, plus a B.Ed. (or an integrated B.Ed. route) with at least 50% marks, plus proficiency to teach in Hindi and English medium. A Master Degree in Physics counts if Physics was also studied at graduation level.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The monthly pro rata payment is Rs. 27500/-, with remuneration as per KVS norms.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form, photocopies of all educational qualifications, and originals of Academic/Professional/Caste certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A selection panel is prepared on merit basis, and a screening test may be conducted as per need.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is part-time and purely on contractual basis for the session 2026-27, and selected candidates are called as and when a vacancy arises, in order of priority in the panel.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
